claims: According to reports on April 18, 2026, the New York Giants traded Dexter Lawrence to the Cincinnati Bengals.
The Cincinnati Bengals acquired Dexter Lawrence in exchange for their 2026 first-round draft pick (No. 10 overall).
Dexter Lawrence requested a trade following a contract impasse.
Dexter Lawrence sought a new contract.
The New York Giants fulfilled Dexter Lawrence's trade request rather than meeting his salary demands.
Dexter Lawrence recorded 31 tackles in the 2025 season.
Dexter Lawrence recorded half a sack in the 2025 season.
The New York Giants hold two top-10 picks in the 2026 draft.
The trade occurred just before the NFL Draft.
The Cincinnati Bengals ranked 31st in total defense.
Dexter Lawrence is a defensive tackle.
Dexter Lawrence will receive a new extension in Cincinnati.
